Delhi High Court
Union Of India vs M/S Bright Power Projects on 16 January, 2023
Citations: 2023 DHC 1234

Hon'ble Mr. Justice Yashwant Varma

1. This petition under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 challenges the arbitral award dated 15 November 2022.

2. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, the court finds no merit in the objections raised.

3. The petition is accordingly dismissed with costs.
